milestones.observedChange: The flat 1:100 hillside section gains perspective while retaining the same stair spine, three levels, pool and slope.

milestones.label: M03

milestones.label: M04
milestones.observedChange: The street-level kitchen, dining area and roof lantern occupy the section window while the same stair remains adjacent.

milestones.label: M05

milestones.label: M06

reverseSemanticStates: Discovery reverse returns from the editorial footer through selected work to the section, then reverses the pool, living, bedroom, kitchen and stair framing, material sweep and lens opening. Portrait additionally traverses right and left section halves. No independent reverse-only geometry state was established; A0/A1 still require explicit comparison.
